Three upstream components move forward together, and the container's boot log gets the house banner treatment. Nothing changes about how the image is configured, so this is a straight update.

## ✨ Added

- **Synapse [v1.159.0](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.159.0)**, up from v1.158.0.
- **Matrix Authentication Service [1.23.0](https://github.com/element-hq/matrix-authentication-service/releases/tag/v1.23.0)**, up from 1.22.0. Only reached when Delegated Auth is switched on; the default path is untouched.
- **Element Web [v1.12.26](https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/releases/tag/v1.12.26)**, up from v1.12.25.

## 🎨 Design

- **New knight ASCII banner, and the title now sits on one line.** The name and subtitle used to take a line each, which pushed the READY status further from the artwork it belongs to. Banner, title and status now form one block, and it stays the last thing this container prints on boot, so it is what you see when the log settles rather than something you have to scroll back for.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A rotated Docker Hub token no longer takes the whole build down.** The mirror login was gated on the username variable alone. With the variable set and the token missing or rotated, the login step failed, and because it is not optional that failure ended the job, including the GHCR push that was working perfectly well. Both halves are required now, so a missing token skips the mirror instead of breaking the build.
- **The image-exists check looks at every registry it publishes to.** It only ever inspected GHCR. Turning the Docker Hub mirror on for a tag GHCR already had meant scheduled runs skipped the build forever while Docker Hub stayed empty, which matters because the Community Applications template points at the Docker Hub image. A tag missing on either side is now a reason to build.
- **README had the push direction backwards.** It described the image as pushed to Docker Hub and mirrored to GHCR. It is the other way round: GHCR always, Docker Hub only when the mirror is configured.
